scope: Five missing limited SS sprites; existing SSS excluded

specs.name: 나무늘봉순
specs.detail: Adult female snow sniper, exactly the approved face, brown flowing hair, bangs and white earmuffs, white ribbed winter crop top, white shorts with black/gold harnesses, gloves and tall fur-trim white snow boots. Her original long white/black cyan-magenta illustrated sniper rifle MUST retain its complete approved design, straight long barrel and aligned scope. She is facing screen-right in a poised combat stance, holding that rifle with both hands at chest/shoulder height; the receiver/barrel/muzzle lie on ONE perfectly straight horizontal axis pointing directly RIGHT, allowing a projectile to continue directly in front of the muzzle. Buttstock seated naturally, right hand at trigger, left hand under foregrip, no floating fingers. Include the original black/white blue-eyed husky standing beside and slightly behind her legs on the left, separated cleanly from boots. No snow ground. Rifle entire length visible. Do not use twin SMGs.

Asset: a SINGLE transparent-background full-body 2D battle sprite (called SD in this project), derived from the approved source artwork. NOT a character card and NOT chibi.

Composition: a single combat-ready isolated sprite oriented toward screen-right; natural face in three-quarter view, not a frontal pinup pose.

specs.name: 조은
specs.detail: Adult female heavy-cannon operator. Preserve this exact approved face, long black flowing hair, white short-sleeved collared shirt and black tie, white/black shoulder armor, black harness and fingerless gloves, short black skirt/skort, thigh straps and black ankle boots. Combat stance with both feet on one ground level, facing screen-right, slightly bent knees bracing weight, no crate. Hold the exact original enormous expanded-rail laser cannon at chest/waist height with the rear receiver supported under her arm and other hand under foregrip. Preserve all features: long cyan exposed core, straight black parallel top and bottom rails, top scope, heavy rear receiver, round open front muzzle. The entire cannon must be ONE rigid object with perfectly straight horizontal receiver-to-muzzle axis, aiming RIGHT, scope and rails parallel. Do not bend the front downward, pinch the middle, curve the rails, shorten the cannon, narrow the muzzle, redesign the weapon or aim at the camera. Fit the wrists and fingers naturally to this rigid cannon. Show entire muzzle plus clear transparent space in front.

specs.name: 이네스
specs.detail: Adult female violet sorceress preserving exact approved face, long flowing natural black hair, original upright black animal ears (no added ears), black choker, white wrapped sleeveless crop top and white wrapped forearms, black/burgundy layered short skirt with belts and red potion cylinder. Extend her full body naturally to the feet, with simple slim black leather mid-calf fantasy boots consistent with her black/burgundy outfit. Natural adult proportions, long limbs, not chibi. Three-quarter combat stance facing RIGHT, feet firmly grounded, screen-right arm extended at chest height, palm open upward and forward to the right as a clean spell-emission point; other arm relaxed and slightly bent. No glowing orb or aura baked into the sprite: magic will be composed separately. Preserve fingers and exposed palm readability.

specs.name: 오리꿍
specs.detail: The exact yellow duck musketeer from reference, original cute duck proportions, orange beak and webbed feet, glossy black eyes, extravagant black/burgundy gold-embroidered musketeer hat with burgundy feathers and masquerade mask, black/burgundy embroidered coat, white frill cuffs/cravat, black puff trousers and one restrained burgundy/gold shoulder cape. Standing planted combat-ready on both webbed feet, facing screen RIGHT. Holds exactly the approved burgundy wooden/gold ornate crossbow with both wings/hands; straighten the crossbow's bolt-guide axis to horizontal pointing RIGHT, single rigid crossbow structure with symmetrical bow arms and taut string, one straight silver bolt aligned in the guide and front arrowhead visible. Hands wrap naturally around trigger stock and front support, no human body, no extra fingers. Keep original mascot anatomy, full hat and feet visible.

specs.name: 디임
specs.detail: Adult female moon-crystal mage preserving exactly the approved face and natural flowing long brown hair with bangs, white rose/feather and crystal masquerade hair ornament, fine gold/blue jewelry, white/gold elegant high-slit gown with sheer embroidered sleeves, hanging blue crystals and white/gold tall boots. Standing gracefully on both feet in three-quarter combat stance facing screen RIGHT, no seat or throne. Same tall rigid gold filigree staff with crescent crown and blue diamond crystal, held beside her body; full staff and crystal visible. Extend free hand gently toward screen-right at chest height with open visible palm; this is a separate magic-emission anchor. Dress follows a controlled natural flow with 1-2 folds, no giant billowing cape. No baked-in glowing orb, star, aura or spell effects.
